shared: Knights grow huge by standing alone, with empty slots feeding one or a few champions.
differ: The core rule: the bigger unit takes stats, Knights next to Knights go blank, or pre-fight hits kill.

takes.label: Raid the shop
takes.line: One rule: the bigger unit takes from the smaller, on your board, in the shop and in fights, so refreshes grow you.
takes.look_if: growth from refreshing the shop, and every trade a bet on size.

takes.label: Three lonely stations
takes.line: A Knight next to another Knight goes blank; three hold stations, units between are fed or drained, heirs wake when elders die.
takes.look_if: Knights that switch each other off, and heirs waking mid-fight.

takes.label: Pre-fight knockouts
takes.line: Before the fight, units trade one hit with the enemy across to kill it; a chequerboard of four lone units all grow.
takes.look_if: kills before the fight, and a giant multiplied by every empty slot.
